card.name: Slash-joined fetal/neonatal and place lead-ins
card.fires_on: Mostly the start of "neonatal" after "Fetal/" in pregnancy headings. Also small linking words (called, in, with, given, a colon) just before a named item or place.

modes.label: Fetal/Neonatal split
modes.description: The piece "Ne" or "/ne" that begins "neonatal" after "Fetal/" or "embryo-fetal" in pregnancy warnings.

modes.label: Linking word before a name
modes.description: A short word or colon that comes right before a proper name, place, or drug name.
